definitions.explanation: The quality of being practical, useful, or functional in real-world situations. Often used to evaluate products, designs, or ideas.

examples.japanese: {実用性|じつようせい}が{高|たか}い。
デザインよりも{実用性|じつようせい}を{重視|じゅうし}する。
この{鞄|かばん}は{見|み}た{目|め}はシンプルだが、{実用性|じつようせい}に{優|すぐ}れている。
examples.english: This bag looks simple, but it excels in practicality.

notes:
Formed from {実用|じつよう} (practical use) + {性|せい} (quality/nature). Describes how useful or functional something is in practice, as opposed to being merely theoretical or decorative.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実用性|じつようせい}が{高|たか}い: highly practical
- {実用性|じつようせい}に{優|すぐ}れる: to excel in practicality
- {実用性|じつようせい}を{重視|じゅうし}する: to prioritize practicality
- {実用性|じつようせい}に{欠|か}ける: to lack practicality

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {利便性|りべんせい}: convenience — focuses on ease of use rather than overall usefulness
- {機能性|きのうせい}: functionality — focuses on how well features work
- {実用的|じつようてき}: practical (na-adjective form) — used as a modifier rather than a standalone quality
